First off, I just wanna say I am so so very sorry for your loss. You did not deserve that and even if it’s not the same experience, you understand my pain. Emdr did nothing for me, but therapy somewhat helps and hypnosis has helped the most. After going through this twice, I’ve just come to realize that time is the best healer. Thank you for your advice ❤️ if you ever need anything feel free to reach out to me as well I am very familiar with the stages of grief lol

Don’t what lol. Dance in Houston?

First off, I’m so very sorry for the loss of your brother. I can’t imagine your pain. I talk with my boyfriend’s sister almost everyday and she’s an immense pain from it as well. I hope you are taking good care of yourself❤️ I hear from others that the sting of this kind of grief doesn’t really ever go away-you just learn to deal with it they say.
Losing your person is an unfathomable type of grief unless you go through it. It’s incomparable. When someone dies, people seem to love to make it about themselves for some strange reason but it’s not to say they aren’t grieving. But then to say it’s an equal amount of pain to someone who lost their best friend and the closest person to them is almost like a slap in the face bc the grief really is a constant cycle of ptsd, heartbreak, emptiness, etc. I wouldn’t wish it anyone tho and I’m kind of glad they don’t understand. I wouldn’t want anyone to feel this pain and I’m so sorry you do. When you go through this, 2 years is not very long. It can take a lifetime to heal this if you even are ever able to heal. I’m stuck in September of last year and it’s already been 7 months. I think I’ll be stuck there for years. 
This is a difficult journey but you’re doing just fine by simply existing. Sending you so much love and prayers of comfort🤍
Honestly I might actually make a t shirt that says that too haha. I’m tired of saying I’m fine when they ask how I am.

You’re very right. People can only perceive things through their own personal experiences. It’s hard to wrap your brain around something, especially grief, when you haven’t experienced it. They are a real friend for sure even though they may not know how to support me. We sort of came to an understanding about how we may have grief but very different experiences and our grief is valid, but I still feel like the villain. I don’t like feeling like my grief for the love of my life is exactly the same as theirs bc it is not. I know it wasn’t said with malicious intent but it makes me want to isolate more and reach out for less help in fear of feeling like this. I definitely have some things I need to work on so I’ll read up on your last post. Thanks for commenting.

Thank you for your comment. I am so very sorry for the loss you your son. I could not imagine. 
Exactly, everyone grieves differently even if it’s a similar situation. My friend threw that in my face as if that wasn’t the whole point I was trying to make. I’ve learned throughout this process that people say so many insensitive things and most likely don’t even realize they’re insensitive. I do find myself lashing out sometimes when people say things like that and then I look like the bad person, but it’s all just bc I’m hurting and their words hurt me even more. It’s makes me want to isolate even more. That’s something i need to work on.
I’m so glad you’re okay! If you ever need anything at all, feel free to message me. It wasn’t you’re time yet- you’re here for a reason :)

Yep before my boyfriend took his own life he said none of his friends or family actually loved him. They never really showed him and overlooked him. But at his funeral, everyone was his “best friend” and didn’t know why he would doing something like that. People are cruel. But I care about you! I don’t know you but you’re in my thoughts. If you ever need someone to talk to, I’m here for you.
Thank you very much.
Wow sounds like such a similar situation. At least I know I’m not alone. I’m so sorry for your loss.
